checks: Period totals and realized profit reconcile
Every Box and date filter reconciles with totals
Accepted shipping counts immediately without dispatch; duplicates deduplicate; failed request excluded
Pending is end-date stock including earlier purchases, independent of start
Historical pending excludes future choices; shipped date alone is not a request
Inclusive days implemented as half-open UTC timestamps

Cross-day attribution uses original payment, actual buyback, excludes pending and deduplicates outcomes
Missing cost or original payment propagates; real losses stay negative
Dates reject reverse, invalid, future and excessive intervals
Unrealized end-date balance splits opened/no choice and unopened original payments
